verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's own docs describe one-line scenario creation that matches the story's examples (a hire wave, a slipped quarter, a downside growth case, several at once), plus what-if analysis and unlimited scenarios on pricing. Nothing shows a side-by-side comparison view, so the comparison half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented side-by-side scenario comparison, detail on how scenarios are stored and switched, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create scenarios (a hiring wave, a slipped quarter, a downside case) and compare them side by side

citations.quote: Scenarios you ask for in one line: a hire wave, a slipped quarter, a downside growth case, several at once.
